instructions: In a small bowl, stir the kinako and powdered sugar together.
Spread the butter over the toast while it is hot, so it melts in.
Sprinkle a generous 1 1/2 tbsp of the kinako sugar over each slice and serve right away.
method_notes: The one source that names this dish, a Japanese bread company's page repeated on a Japanese products blog, gives only the order: butter or margarine on toast, then kinako, then powdered sugar or a brown syrup. It gives no amounts, so the quantities here are Pomona's own, about two parts kinako to one part sugar, like the kinako sugar a Cookpad Japan toast uses. No ratings exist for any version, so the page counts as a fallback lead.
